Q: How should document identity and revision identity be modeled without forbidding multiple documents per owner?
spoken: Give the document a stable identity and model revisions under that document, with a key such as document_id plus revision. Scope ownership through the document relationship. A uniqueness rule on owner_id and revision alone can incorrectly prevent two unrelated documents from both having revision one. Use constraints that encode the actual entity invariant.
